title: Music Genre Classification
description: Designed a PyTorch deep learning pipeline for music genre predictions. Engineered robust Librosa audio feature extractors (Mel-spectrograms, MFCCs) and resolved domain shift discrepancies between clean audio training stems and noisy real-world composites using fine-tuned pretrained deep networks, tracked via Weights & Biases.

title: Home Service v2
description: Developed a full-stack, multi-role home service booking and dispatch system for IIT Madras Modern Application Development 2 (MAD2) coursework. Implemented Celery for automated background triggers, Redis for responsive data caching, and designed clean interactive client-professional workflows.
